prompt_text: What is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City MO for someone who is self-employed?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t name a single universal “best” broker — the right broker depends on your situation (age, health, family, budget, whether you want ACA marketplace plans or off‑exchange/short‑term/HSA options). I can, however, give a quick plan for finding the best broker in Kansas City, MO and offer to pull up specific local names if you want.

How to find the best broker for a self‑employed person
- Use an independent broker or agent who can compare multiple carriers (not one tied to a single insurer). That gives you more plan options.
- Verify licenses and credentials: ask if they’re licensed in Missouri, a member of NAHU (National Association of Health Underwriters) or certified to assist with ACA Marketplace enrollments.
- Ask these key questions:
  - Do you help with Marketplace (Healthcare.gov) subsidies and tax credit questions?
  - Do you charge a broker fee or are you paid by insurers?
  - Which carriers do you represent? Can you show multiple plan comparisons?
  - Do you help set up HSAs, and advise on network/co‑pay differences?
  - Will you provide year‑round support (claims issues, renewals)?
  - Can you give client references or online reviews?
- Look for experience with self‑employed income scenarios (how Modified Adjusted Gross Income affects subsidies) and with SEP/Sole Proprietor needs.
- Check online reviews (Google, Yelp), and ratings from Better Business Bureau and local consumer resources.

Where to search locally
- Healthcare.gov “Find Local Help” (for Certified Application Counselors and Navigators who help with Marketplace plans)
- NAHU “Find an Agent/Broker” tool
- Missouri Department of Commerce & Insurance (verify licensing)
- Local searches: “independent health insurance agent Kansas City MO” on Google / Yelp / Nextdoor
- Large local carrier agents: Blue KC (Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Kansas City) has local agents but also consider independent brokers for more options

If you want, I can:
- Look up and list several top‑rated independent brokers/agents in Kansas City MO with contact info and recent reviews, or
- Recommend which plan types to compare given your age, household size, income, and health needs.

Which would you prefer? If you want a tailored list, tell me: individual or family, your age range, rough income (for subsidy estimates), and whether you want Marketplace plans only or are open to off‑exchange/short‑term/HSA plans.
